mapper.select: SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME AS C_NAME, COUNT(HRT.H_IDX) AS HEART_COUNT FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' GROUP BY BRD.B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME ORDER BY BRD.B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME AS C_NAME, COUNT(HRT.H_IDX) AS HEART_COUNT FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' AND BRD.B_IDX < #{lastBIdx} GROUP BY BRD.B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME ORDER BY BRD.B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NAME AS C_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT HRT.H_IDX) AS COUNT FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON HRT.H_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_IDX = #{b_idx}
SELECT IMG.I_IDX AS I_IDX, IMG.I_B_IDX AS I_B_IDX, IMG.I_IMAGE AS I_IMAGE FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN IMAGE_FILE IMG ON IMG.I_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_IDX = #{b_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ALARM (A_B_IDX, A_U_IDX, A_TYPE, A_URL) VALUES (#{a_b_idx}, #{a_u_idx}, #{a_type}, #{a_url})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM HEART WHERE H_U_IDX = #{h_u_idx} AND H_B_IDX = #{h_b_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (B_U_IDX, B_TITLE, B_CONTENT) VALUES (#{b_u_idx}, #{b_title}, #{b_content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS COUNT FROM HEART HRT JOIN BOARD BRD ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX WHERE B_IDX = #{b_idx}

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, COUNT(DISTINCT HRT.H_IDX) AS LIKE_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT COM.CM_IDX) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX AND HRT.H_IDX IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN COMMENT COM ON BRD.B_IDX = COM.CM_B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' AND BRD.B_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY BRD.B_IDX ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, BRD.B_DATE DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, COUNT(HRT.H_IDX) AS LIKE_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT COM.CM_IDX) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX LEFT JOIN COMMENT COM ON BRD.B_IDX = COM.CM_B_IDX AND HRT.H_IDX IS NOT NULL WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' AND BRD.B_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY BRD.B_IDX ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, BRD.B_DATE DESC LIMIT 10
